invocation_scope: C12 long_horizon Replay Gap reproduction/reconstruction audit
actions: Inspected the sealed C12 evaluation, cross_field, long_horizon and neuroscience source artifacts and selected the long_horizon Replay Gap branch for audit because it had the strongest executable public harness/data footprint plus uncertain reconstruction-replication scope.

Inspected the official Replay Gap README, paper source, dataset card, pilot config, requirements, branching implementation, metric implementation, fidelity aggregation, smoke test, analysis scripts and committed divergence/result artifacts.
Searched fresh exact-title/repository/dataset sources for a protocol-matched independent rerun and did not locate one; treated this as not-located rather than evidence of absence.

Mechanically traced the production replay-fidelity criterion and found that it compares recorded versus replayed action return codes only; the branch model is seeded with recorded prefix messages after replay.

Executed a local criterion counterexample in which the same state-writing shell command returned code 0 on both executions while producing different state content, demonstrating that return-code equality alone cannot establish environment-state equality.
Published and read back an immutable source-scoped audit without inventing a C12 canonical candidate key.
Advanced the reproducibility CURRENT pointer/frontier with CAS while preserving prior immutable audits.

outputs.assessment: B+ overall; official harness/data A-; public action-level numerical artifact support B+; independent same-protocol replication not located; 707/708 exact-reconstruction wording narrowed because released aggregation operationalizes exactness as return-code-perfect only

scope_guard.reason: The sealed long_horizon source artifact does not declare a stable source-local candidate id for this Replay Gap evidence branch. Attach later only if the final C12 canonical pair supplies an exact declared id mechanically bound to the same source blob.
not_claimed: The fidelity-scope defect is not treated as a contradiction of Replay Gap action-divergence results.
No claim is made that released branches actually experienced hidden state drift.
No claim is made that no independent reproduction exists; only that none was located in this search.

blockers_or_limits: A full six-run rerun requires x86_64 Docker/SWE-bench, large disk and both model-serving configurations; this invocation environment did not support that full rerun.
vLLM and SWE-bench are not version-pinned by the public requirements file, reducing exact future environment reconstruction.
No stronger released task-state/observation digest audit was located in the inspected official artifact set.

termination.cause: physical invocation budget/end with nonempty frontier
